verdict.rationale: The skill ships as plain folders of `SKILL.md` instruction files plus a disclosed set of six standard-library Python scripts that do not touch the network. It can also be installed by manually copying folders into `.claude/skills/`, so a reviewer can read every instruction and script file. There is no documented manifest or pre-install listing of contents, so review relies on reading the files themselves. Missing for 10: an explicit file manifest or pre-install content listing, documentation enumerating every script and instruction file by name, and independent corroboration of the scripts' behavior.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward

citations.quote: Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
